name: capture_camera_snapshot
description: Capture a fresh snapshot from a Ring camera and ALWAYS mint it as a pod the agent can immediately attach to email or pass to vision tools. Use this — not ring_camera_control.get_snapshot — when you need the resulting image as a usable pod (e.g. 'email me a current shot of the downstairs camera'). The background camera dispatcher's skip-unless-interesting pod policy doesn't apply here — the pod gets minted regardless of analyzed scene category.

inputs.name: camera_id
inputs.description: Ring camera id. Use ring_camera_control.list_cameras to look one up by name if you don't know it.

outputs.description: Human-readable confirmation including the minted pod_id.
{ok, pod_id, camera_id, snapshot_path, captured_at, size_bytes, mime_type}. Use pod_id immediately in pod_ids=[...] for send_email or input_pod_ids=[...] for vision/execute_code tools.

arguments_prompt:
Arguments for capture_camera_snapshot:
- camera_id (required): Ring camera id (e.g. '158991560' for Downstairs).
